claim.text: Neuvostoliitto lavasti 26. marraskuuta 1939 Mainilan laukaukset , joilla se perusteli sotaa puolustuksellisena toimenpiteenä.

lives.text: On November 26 the Soviets staged the Shelling of Mainila , an incident in which Soviet artillery shelled areas near the Russian village of Mainila, then announced that a Finnish artillery attack had killed Soviet troops.
On 26 November, a border incident was reported near the village of Mainila .

On 26 November 1939, an incident was reported near the Soviet village of Mainila close to the border with Finland: A Soviet border guard post had been shelled by an unknown party resulting, according to Soviet reports, in the deaths of four and injuries of nine border guards.
On 26 November 1939, an incident was reported near the Soviet village of Mainila , close to the border with Finland.
On 26 November 1939, an incident was reported near the Soviet village of Mainila , near the border with Finland.

Am 26. November inszenierte die Rote Armee im Dorf Mainila ( russisch Майнило ) einen Grenzzwischenfall, bei dem angeblich sowjetische Truppen von finnischer Artillerie beschossen worden seien ( Mainila-Zwischenfall ).

В тот же день произошёл артиллерийский обстрел территории СССР у населённого пункта Майнила , инсценированный советской стороной — что также подтверждается соответствующими распоряжениями Маннергейма, уверенного в неизбежности советской провокации и потому предварительно отведшего войска от границы на расстояние, исключающее возникновение недоразумений.
